title: 18.2 A 12.2µW 99.6dB-SNDR 184.8dB-FOMs DT Zoom PPD ΔΣM with Gain-Embedded Bootstrapped Sampler
problem: Discrete-time (DT) delta-sigma modulators require large sampling capacitors to achieve high resolution, imposing huge driving burden on input buffers to settle charges; the input driver dominates power consumption while most current is wasted through passive components.
motivation: High-resolution audio and sensor interfaces demand ultra-low-power ADCs; reducing input stage power consumption is critical for battery-powered IoT and medical devices.
method: The 12.2µW DT zoom PPD ΔΣM employs a gain-embedded bootstrapped sampler that integrates gain into the sampling stage, reducing settling requirements and input buffer current demands while maintaining high linearity and SNDR performance.
key_novelty: Gain-embedded bootstrapped sampler architecture reducing input-stage power consumption in high-resolution DT ΔΣMs.
contributions: Gain-embedded bootstrapped sampler for reduced input-stage power
